mainEntity.name: How much does a Range Rover Evoque 2.2 diesel engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full rebuilt Range Rover Evoque 2.2 diesel engine typically costs between £2,200 and £3,200 for supply only. Reconditioned units start around £1,800, while used engines can be found from £800. Prices vary based on whether you choose supply-only or a full supply and fit service.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of turbo or timing chain failure in a Range Rover Evoque 2.2 diesel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early warning signs include loss of power, excessive smoke (blue or black), turbo whining noise, or a rattling noise on cold start from the timing chain. You might also experience intermittent limp mode or boost pressure warnings.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Range Rover Evoque 2.2 diesel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for well-maintained, higher-value examples. A Range Rover Evoque 2.2 diesel in good condition holds a value of £5,000 to £12,000+. Investing £2,200-£3,200 in a rebuilt engine with a 12-month warranty is financially viable if you plan to keep the vehicle long-term, though lower-value examples may warrant a used engine or part-exchange evaluation.

mainEntity.name: What is the DW12/224DT engine code in the Range Rover Evoque 2.2 diesel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The DW12 (also coded as 224DT) is the specific 2.2-litre four-cylinder PSA-derived Duratorq diesel engine fitted to the Range Rover Evoque (2011-2015). It was available in eD4 (150hp), TD4 (150hp), and SD4 (190hp) power outputs, featuring a variable geometry turbocharger and common-rail injection.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Range Rover Evoque 2.2 diesel engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional supply and fit service for a Range Rover Evoque 2.2 diesel typically takes 2 to 3 working days. This includes the removal of the old unit, thorough cleaning of the engine bay, installation of the replacement engine, and comprehensive system testing.

historyTimeline.h2: Range Rover Evoque 2.2 Diesel - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: Launched in 2011, the Range Rover Evoque 2.2 diesel brought robust PSA-derived power to the premium compact SUV segment, utilising the proven DW12 architecture to deliver strong torque and respectable fuel economy during the first generation (L538) production run.

milestones.description: DW12/224DT engine code introduced, 2.2L, 150-190hp (PSA/Ford-derived Duratorq diesel, available in eD4, TD4 and SD4 power outputs for the original L538 Evoque).
2.2 diesel phased out in favour of the 2.0 Ingenium diesel (204DTD) for the facelifted Evoque, though many 2.2 diesel models remained in active service across the UK.

problems.group: Turbocharger VGT Failure & Timing Chain Wear
problems.h4: Turbocharger VGT Failure & Timing Chain Wear - Why the Range Rover Evoque 2.2 Diesel DW12 Requires Attention
problems.rootCause: Variable geometry turbocharger (VGT) vanes become coked with soot from extended oil change intervals or poor-quality oil. Vane sticking causes overboost or underboost, eventually leading to turbo bearing failure. Additionally, timing chain stretch can occur on high-mileage units.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Turbo clean & VGT actuator replacement, timing chain inspection
repairOptions.longevity: Suitable for early-stage sticking (intermittent limp mode) or chain rattle without jump

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, new turbo, timing chain kit, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: The definitive solution for catastrophic turbo failure or confirmed chain stretch/jump

Note: For sub-£5,000 examples, a full rebuilt engine cost (£2,200-£3,200) may approach 50-60% of the vehicle's current market value. Evaluate scrap or part-exchange value carefully before committing to a full rebuild.
problems.recommendation: If your Evoque 2.2 diesel is exhibiting early signs of turbo lag or intermittent boost issues, a targeted turbo clean and actuator replacement (£500-£900) is highly cost-effective. However, if the turbo has already failed catastrophically (smoke, whining, loss of power) or you hear timing chain rattle, a full rebuilt unit with new turbo and chain kit is the only reliable long-term solution to protect your investment.
